protocol.aggregate: exp(sum(answer NLL) / sum(scored answer tokens)); not mean per-answer PPL
protocol.bos: one reference BOS at start when defined; no extra EOS
protocol.boundary: encode prompt and answer separately with add_special_tokens=False, then concatenate
protocol.loss: causal next-token NLL on all answer tokens, including the first; no prompt or padding loss
protocol.prompt: source-generation-prompt; source chat template, not reference chat template
protocol.source_tokenizer_selection: explicit override, otherwise row.model_path; fallback assumes the generation tokenizer matches that checkpoint
protocol.weights_fingerprint: weight filenames, sizes and mtime_ns; weight contents are not hashed
